# Vendored Wayfinder skill

This directory contains an unmodified snapshot of Matt Pocock's Wayfinder
skill at revision `84fdeffd12f2ee307994d1eb6feb48173b6e0502`.

Upstream source:
https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/blob/84fdeffd12f2ee307994d1eb6feb48173b6e0502/skills/engineering/wayfinder/SKILL.md

The snapshot is distributed under its original MIT License. Do not remove the
adjacent `LICENSE` file when copying, modifying or redistributing the skill.

AI Work OS installs this snapshot as a separate `wayfinder` skill. Local
changes to the vendored file should be recorded prominently and must preserve
the original MIT notice.

Wayfinder refers to the companion skills `grilling`, `domain-modeling`,
`research` and `prototype`. Those files are not copied by this snapshot. The
AI Work OS Business Wayfinder contract provides a portable fallback: a client
uses an installed companion skill when available and otherwise performs the
same responsibility with its native interviewing, research, modeling or
prototyping capabilities.
